blocks.text: Is chapter mein shamil tha ke online mehfooz kaise rahein, hamle kaise hote aur un ka difa kaise karein, munsifana ishtirak aur design kaise karein, digital karobar kaise shuru karein, aur computing ke saath aane wali akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati zimmedariyan. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter 9 ki kaleedi istilahat
rows: Cybersecurity
Computers, networks, data aur accounts ko be-ijazat rasai, ghalat istemal, nuqsan ya hamle se bachana
Online hifazat
Zaati maloomat, devices aur digital shanakht bachane ke liye Internet ka ehtiyat se istemal
Mazboot password
Mushkil se andaza lagne wala password jis mein chhote bare huroof, numbers aur symbols hon
Privacy settings / privacy policy
Options jo control karein ke aap ki maloomat kaun dekhe / bayan ke app ya website data kaise jama, use, mehfooz aur share karti
Digital ishtirak / digital adaab
Mushtarka tools se online mil kar kaam / online shaista, izzat-dar, zimmedarana rawaiya
Cyber khatra
Digital systems, data ya users ko koi bhi khatra, jaise phishing, malware, ransomware, hacking aur shanakht ki chori
Phishing / malware / ransomware
Jaali paighamat ya sites jo dhoke se tafseel lein / nuqsandeh software / files band kar ke paisa mangne wala malware
Two-factor authentication / biometric tasdeeq
Do tasdeeqein, jaise password aur phone code / fingerprint, chehre ya awaz se shanakht
Firewall / antivirus software
Security qawaid se aane jane wala traffic control / nuqsandeh software pakarna, rokna aur hatana
Cryptography / data ki hifazat
Maloomat ko aisi mehfooz shakal dena jo sirf ijazat yafta parh sakein / maloomat ko zaya, ghalat istemal, chori ya be-ijazat rasai se bachana
Rasai (accessibility)
Aise systems design karna jo mukhtalif salahiyat, zarooraton aur pas-e-manzar ke log asani se use karein
Intellectual property / data privacy qawaneen
Zehan ki qanooni milkiyat wali takhleeqat / zaati data ke jama, mehfooz, use aur share hone ke qawaneen
E-waste / paidar computing
Phenke gaye electronic devices / mahoolyati nuqsan kam karne ke liye technology ka istemal, design aur khatma
Entrepreneurship / digital entrepreneurship
Jiddat wale karobari khayalat aur mauqe banana / Internet, social media, e-commerce aur digital tools se karobar

items: Mehfooz aadatein aur settings; khatre aur difa (2FA, firewalls, encryption).
Masawat aur rasai ke saath ishtirak; digital entrepreneurship.
Akhlaqiyat, qanoon (GDPR, PECA) aur mahol (e-waste, paidar computing).
